source: PM Monday gap list, decision d-voicuo (2026-10-18)

code-home.powers: File table, latest commit, branch count and README. No Releases block; only sync state in the Monday sidebar.

tree-file.powers: Maximized tree/blob; Copy permalink; whole files up to 512 KiB, otherwise size and raw link; branch or full SHA; selected lines can be asked about. Make TODO, tags and short SHA are hidden.

issues.powers: Public signed-out list and threads; signed-in New issue form; truthful error, loading and empty states. Make TODO and Implement are hidden.

pulls.powers: Public list and PR commits/checks/files; human review copy follows the claim rule. Merge is held with Merge on GitHub; Stack is hidden.

ask.powers: Docked composer at 1440; collapsed at 1280; sheet on phone. Signed-out Ask goes to sign-in. Hosted agent acts show a held reason and copyable local CLI command.

commits.powers: Public read-only history per ref, git SHAs and marked agent commits. No hosted run links.

commit.powers: Public maximized SHA commit and diff; browse files at that commit. No hosted run or landing controls.

branches.powers: Public read-only branch list. Fork, Rebase, Archive and Run on a sandbox are hidden.

flows.primary: Held state and copyable smthrs flow start <name>
flows.powers: Read-only .smithers/flows list and blob source; held local CLI command. No graph, triggers or hosted execution.

settings.primary: Read Models held text or GitHub sync state
settings.powers: Members only. Minimal Models held text and GitHub sync state. Model connections arrive with hosted runs; locally smthrs uses Claude Code or Codex login. No other settings or Save action.

search.powers: Code and issue search with real results. Keep through increment 2; if cut at 20:00, add search to cut.views and search to cut.headerPieces.

notes: Set activeIncrement to 1 for the first live walk; Flows/Settings tabs appear with increment 2. Docs is required only for repositories whose live-routes.json declaredTabs includes Docs. Search stays in increment 2 unless explicitly cut at 20:00. Cut routes are excluded, not claimed verified absent; kept-page evidence checks visible cut tabs, header pieces, sidebar blocks and links.
